title: NasGovernanceReceipt
description: Explicit, operator-attested governance state of the Evidence Vault. Production capture MUST NOT start without this receipt. Every control is tri-state: a protection that does not exist is recorded NOT_AVAILABLE with a compensating control -- the implementation may never invent a PASS.

attestedBy.description: Human operator who confirmed DSM-side facts. MUST be null while attestationState is DRAFT_UNATTESTED, and MUST be a person when ATTESTED. An agent may never name itself here.

state.description: CONFIRMED: present and enabled. DISABLED: the capability EXISTS on this platform but is switched off -- do not call an available-but-off capability NOT_AVAILABLE. NOT_CONFIGURED: the mechanism exists and may even have run once, but no active policy governs it. NOT_AVAILABLE: actually checked and genuinely not present on this platform. NOT_APPLICABLE: does not apply. UNKNOWN is a FAILING state meaning NOT YET CHECKED.

detail.description: What was actually configured or why it is unavailable. Never a credential value.

evidence.description: Where this was observed -- DSM screen, CLI output path, ticket.

compensatingControl.description: REQUIRED when state is NOT_AVAILABLE. What mitigates the absence.

accessBoundary.description: The service identity must not hold general NAS access.

commandRestricted.description: Whether the authorized_keys entry restricts the key to the replication command.

verdict.description: ACCEPTED requires attestationState=ATTESTED and every control CONFIRMED, NOT_APPLICABLE, or NOT_AVAILABLE-with-a-compensatingControl. Any UNKNOWN forces INSUFFICIENT. A DRAFT_UNATTESTED receipt is always INSUFFICIENT.

attestationState.description: DRAFT_UNATTESTED means an agent pre-filled machine-observable facts only. It is NOT a partial pass and carries no governance weight. Only a human moves this to ATTESTED.

measuredFacts.description: Facts an agent observed directly, with the command or receipt that produced them. Kept separate from `controls` because measuring capacity is not the same act as attesting a governance control.

observedBy.description: Agent/session that measured these. Distinct from attestedBy.

deviceIdentity.description: Model, DSM version, addresses and management URL. Cite the source and whether it was re-verified.

liveProbe.description: Reachability and service state observed directly from the worker host over native networking.

credentialSurfacesChecked.description: Which credential surfaces were checked and what was found. Existence and naming ONLY -- never values.

dsmInspection.description: Facts read from the live DSM API under an authenticated admin session. Record the API and method that produced each fact, never a credential.

blockers.description: Conditions preventing controls from being resolved. A blocker is not a failure of the receipt -- it is why fields remain UNKNOWN, recorded so the gap is explicit rather than implied.

pathsExhausted.description: What was actually tried, so nobody repeats it.
